workflows.title: Side-effect and access-order review
workflows.stage: design / integration-verification / firmware / bring-up evidence interpretation
workflows.decision: Review register side effects, caller intent and selected diagnostic evidence across destructive reads and recovery.
intent_questions: What operation did the caller intend and which register causes or fields does it own?
Which actual access, lane, clear/reset and observation semantics determine side effects before recovery or acknowledgement?

evidence_roles.meaning: Original independently required behavior, objective or acceptance contract

revalidate_when: Original requirement, applicability, exclusion rationale or receiving decision changes
Selected native entity, source, configuration, mode, tool/model version or extraction method changes
A dependent relationship or observation premise is changed, missing or contradicted

workflows.title: Error recovery and diagnostic validity
workflows.decision: Review error recovery and diagnostic validity through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: Which fault, incident epoch and observation window must this diagnostic consumer answer?
Which actual read response and saved capture survive destructive accesses and reset, rather than substituting a later zero for historical absence?

workflows.title: Bring-up observation validity
workflows.decision: Review bring-up observation validity through existing correction, handoff and revalidation.
intent_questions: Which original pre-silicon expectation, device/image/reset conditions and source-time window define this comparison?
Which actual diagnostic receipt and clock/reset correlation make the observation comparable, rather than merely returning the expected bits?
